Liquidity & Trading Activity
•  Main liquidity sits in a PumpSwap pool paired with TTWO (Take-Two Interactive related token/securities narrative).
•  Liquidity depth is moderate for the market cap (~5–15% of MC depending on the snapshot). Thin enough that large sells can move price meaningfully, but sufficient for current volume.
•  24h activity shows more buys than sells in several recent windows (e.g., thousands of buys vs sells, with buy volume often slightly ahead).
•  High relative volume (volume/MC ratio frequently elevated) indicates active trading interest rather than stagnation.
Token Safety Basics
•  Mint authority: None (revoked).
•  Freeze authority: None.
•  Token program: Token-2022.
•  No major red flags reported on basic audits in available data. Community takeover noted on DexScreener profiles.
•  Creator rewards: 1% directed fully to holders (anyone holding >~$20 qualifies in some descriptions).
Narrative & Context
DacityCoin is a pure meme/community token inspired by a fictional “DacityCoin / AudaCity” reference appearing in GTA 6 trailer material. It graduated from Pump.fun bonding curve and trades primarily on PumpSwap. The GTA 6 link has driven multiple pumps (including early runs from low five-figure MCAP into the millions and the $5M+ ATH). Community activity remains visible on X and related channels.
Overall Assessment
Strengths:
•  Decent holder count growth and relatively distributed top holdings for its age/size.
•  Active volume and recent price strength.
•  Clean basic contract settings (no mint/freeze).
•  Strong narrative tie-in with upcoming GTA 6 interest.
